summary: Iteration 128: Dynamic Model Registration, Heartbeat, and Enable/Disable APIs - 23/23 BACKEND TESTS PASSED. Fixed 1 bug in services/providerrouter.py: dynamically registered providers to new lanes were not storing their config data, causing list_models to return 'unknown' provider and default priority. Added _dynamic_configs class-level storage to persist provider configs for lanes without existing ProviderRouter instances.
seed_data_creation: None - used test providers with prefix 'test-agent-model-128' and 'persistence-test-provider'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 128 tested the NEW dynamic model registration, heartbeat, and enable/disable APIs. All 23 tests pass: (1) Auth tests verify admin-only access for GET /api/provider-health, GET /api/provider-health/models, POST /register, POST /deregister, POST /enable, (2) Heartbeat endpoint is intentionally unauthenticated (services call it themselves), (3) Register persists to MongoDB and appears in /models list with correct provider/model/priority, (4) Heartbeat with status=failed disables provider, (5) Enable re-enables disabled provider, (6) Deregister removes provider from list and DB. Fixed bug: added _dynamic_configs class-level storage to ProviderRouter to store provider configs for dynamically registered providers in lanes without existing instances.

bugs_fixed.issue: Dynamically registered providers to new lanes (without existing ProviderRouter instance) were not storing their config data. list_models returned 'unknown' provider and default priority 999.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added _dynamic_configs class-level dict to store provider configs. Updated register() to store in _dynamic_configs, deregister() to remove from _dynamic_configs, and list_models() to merge _dynamic_configs with instance.providers.
